# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/mankidev/nota/releases/latest) gets fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through the [Security tab](https://github.com/mankidev/nota/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue. Say what an attacker could do, how to reproduce it, and which version you tested.

Once a fix is released, the report is published with credit to you unless you ask otherwise.

## Checking a download

Every release lists the SHA-256 of its APK and of the signing certificate. Releases from 1.3.5 on are signed with this key:

```
7bc157aad15211edbd11148d20fef968a910d40dea6dd3c100e8965828eb355f
```

Releases 1.1 to 1.3.4 were signed with an older key:

```
70e682be49371a962ddaa7b694c84035cd2ccd341734d9bf46ee14a230f89e58
```
